items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: Bill Lee played tenor sax... I was the trombone.

ctx.x: Well who was down there with you other than Joe?

Well, let's see, Joe was playing con-hit, Briss Jones was playing clarinet, Bill Lee played tenor sax, John Chaff, the regular banjo player, played tuba, and the regular drummer, Bob McIntyre, doubled on a banjo. The bass player played a bass drum, and the piano player played a snare drum, and I was the trombone. So all in all, it worked out pretty well, you know.
